77305-gleanings-in-europe.title: Gleanings In Europe
77305-gleanings-in-europe.creator: Unknown
77305-gleanings-in-europe.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It would be quite impossible that the presence of Sir Walter Scott should not excite a sensation. He was frequently named in the journals, received a good deal of private, and some public notice, but, on the whole, much less of both, I think, than one would have a right to expect for him, in a place like Paris.

arxiv-2006-04011.title: A new f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) Gravity Model and properties of Gravitational Waves in it
arxiv-2006-04011.creator: Dhruba Jyoti Gogoi, Umananda Dev Goswami
arxiv-2006-04011.description: Abstract In this paper, we have introduced a new f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity model as an attempt to have a model with more parametric control, so that the model can be used to explain the existing problems as well as to explore new directions in physics of gravity, by properly constraining it with recent observational data.

arxiv-2012-11883.title: A liquid scintillator for a neutrino Detector working at -50 degree Journal: Nuclear Instrument and Method
arxiv-2012-11883.creator: Zhangquan Xie, Jun Cao, Yayun Ding, Mengchao Liu, Xilei Sun, Wei Wang, Yuguang Xie
arxiv-2012-11883.description: Abstract A liquid scintillator (LS) is developed for the Taishan Antineutrino Observatory (TAO), a ton-level neutrino detector to measure the reactor antineutrino spectrum with sub-percent energy resolution by adopting Silicon Photomultipliers (SiPMs) as photosensor. To reduce the dark noise of SiPMs to an acceptable level, the LS has to work at -50 ∘ C or lower.

arxiv-2108-07725.title: Bulging Triangles: Generalization of Reuleaux Triangles
arxiv-2108-07725.creator: Norihiro Someyama
arxiv-2108-07725.description: Abstract We introduce a bulging triangle like the generalization of the Reuleaux triangle. We may be able to propose various ways to bulge a triangle, but this paper presents the way so that its vertices are the same as them of the original triangle. We find some properties and theorems of our bulging triangles.

arxiv-2111-00115.title: Combining Public and Private Data
arxiv-2111-00115.creator: Cecilia Ferrando, Jennifer Gillenwater, Alex Kulesza
arxiv-2111-00115.description: Abstract Differential privacy is widely adopted to provide provable privacy guarantees in data analysis. We consider the problem of combining public and private data (and, more generally, data with heterogeneous privacy needs) for estimating aggregate statistics. We introduce a mixed estimator of the mean optimized to minimize the variance.

arxiv-2203-12468.title: The VoicePrivacy 2022 Challenge Evaluation Plan Version 1.0
arxiv-2203-12468.creator: Natalia Tomashenko, Xin Wang, Xiaoxiao Miao, Hubert Nourtel, Pierre Champion, Massimiliano Todisco, Emmanuel Vincent, Nicholas Evans, Junichi Yamagishi, Jean-François Bonastre
arxiv-2203-12468.description: Abstract For new participants — Executive summary • The task is to develop a voice anonymization system for speech data which conceals the speaker’s voice identity while protecting linguistic content, paralinguistic attributes, intelligibility and naturalness. • Training, development and evaluation datasets are provided in addition to 3 different baseline anonymization systems, evaluation scripts, and metrics.

arxiv-2204-01625.title: Title: Tomography of ultra-relativistic nuclei with polarized photon-gluon collisions Short Title: Quantum Interference Enabled Nuclear Tomography
arxiv-2204-01625.creator: STAR Collaboration
arxiv-2204-01625.description: Abstract A linearly polarized photon can be quantized from the Lorentz-boosted electromagnetic field of a nucleus traveling at ultra-relativistic speed. When two relativistic heavy nuclei pass one another at a distance of a few nuclear radii, the photon from one nucleus may interact through a virtual quark-antiquark pair with gluons from the other nucleus forming a short-lived vector meson (e.g.

arxiv-2205-02096.title: Data Cleansing for Indoor Positioning Wi-Fi Fingerprinting Datasets Thanks: Corresponding Author: D. Quezada Gaibor ( quezada@uji.com ) Thanks: The authors gratefully acknowledge funding from European Union’s Horizon 2020 Research and Innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska Curie grant agree
arxiv-2205-02096.creator: Darwin Quezada-Gaibor 1 , 2 , Lucie Klus 2 , 1 , Joaquín Torres-Sospedra 3 , Elena Simona Lohan 2 , Jari Nurmi 2 , Carlos Granell 1 , and Joaquín Huerta 1
arxiv-2205-02096.description: Abstract Wearable and IoT devices requiring positioning and localisation services grow in number exponentially every year. This rapid growth also produces millions of data entries that need to be pre-processed prior to being used in any indoor positioning system to ensure the data quality and provide a high Quality of Service (QoS) to the end-user.

arxiv-2210-00247.title: Evolutionary behavior in a two-locus system
arxiv-2210-00247.creator: A. M. Diyorov, U. A. Rozikov
arxiv-2210-00247.description: Abstract . In this short note we study a dynamical system generated by a two-parametric quadratic operator mapping 3-dimensional simplex to itself. This is an evolution operator of the frequencies of gametes in a two-locus system. We find the set of all (a continuum set) fixed points and show that each fixed point is non-hyperbolic.

arxiv-2210-16842.title: Curvature estimates on a parabolic flow of Fei-Guo-Phong
arxiv-2210-16842.creator: Yi Li
arxiv-2210-16842.description: Abstract . In [ 2 ] , Fei, Guo and Phong established a criteria for the long-time existence of their parabolic flow from 11 11 -dimensional supergravity, which involves Riemannian curvatures Rm ⁡ ( g ⁡ ( t ) ) {\rm Rm}(g(t)) and 4-forms F ⁡ ( t ) F(t) .

arxiv-2309-09045.title: Temporal Smoothness Regularisers for Neural Link Predictors
arxiv-2309-09045.creator: Manuel Dileo, Pasquale Minervini, Matteo Zignani, Sabrina Gaito
arxiv-2309-09045.description: Abstract Most algorithms for representation learning and link prediction on relational data are designed for static data. However, the data to which they are applied typically evolves over time, including online social networks or interactions between users and items in recommender systems.

arxiv-2312-05258.title: Automated Small Kidney Cancer Detection in Non-Contrast Computed Tomography
arxiv-2312-05258.creator: William McGough ∗,1,2 Thomas Buddenkotte 3,4 Stephan Ursprung 2,5,6 Zeyu Gao 1,2 Grant D. Stewart 2,6,7 Mireia Crispin-Ortuzar 1,2
arxiv-2312-05258.description: Abstract This study introduces an automated pipeline for renal cancer (RC) detection in non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT). In the development of our pipeline, we test three detections models: a shape model, a 2D-, and a 3D axial-sample model. Training (n=1348) and testing (n=64) data were gathered from open sources (KiTS23, Abdomen1k, CT-ORG) and Cambridge University Hospital (CUH).

arxiv-2412-03875.title: Learning to Hash for Recommendation: A Survey
arxiv-2412-03875.creator: Fangyuan Luo, Yankai Chen, Jun Wu, Tong Li, Philip S. Yu, Xue Liu
arxiv-2412-03875.description: Abstract . With the explosive growth of users and items, Recommender Systems are facing unprecedented challenges in terms of retrieval efficiency and storage overhead. Learning to Hash techniques have emerged as a promising solution to these issues by encoding high-dimensional data into compact hash codes.

arxiv-2507-14007.title: The CryptoNeo Threat Modelling Framework (CNTMF): Securing Neobanks and Fintech in Integrated Blockchain Ecosystems
arxiv-2507-14007.creator: Serhan W. Bahar
arxiv-2507-14007.description: Abstract Abstract The rapid integration of blockchain, cryptocurrency, and Web3 technologies into digital banks and fintech operations has created an integrated environment blending traditional financial systems with decentralised elements. This paper introduces the CryptoNeo Threat Modelling Framework (CNTMF), a proposed framework designed to address the risks in these ecosystems, such as oracle manipulation and cross-chain exploits.

pmc-10558877.title: Efficacy of COVID-19 vaccines in inflammatory bowel disease patients receiving anti-TNF therapy: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10558877.creator: Dan Dou, Fangyi Zhang, Xin Deng, Yun Ma, Shuqing Wang, Xingyu Ji, Xihan Zhu, Dianpeng Wang, Shengsheng Zhang, Luqing Zhao
pmc-10558877.description: Background and objectivesThere are concerns about the serological responses to Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) vaccines in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) patients, particularly those receiving anti-TNF therapy. This study aimed to systematically evaluate the efficacy of COVID-19 vaccines in IBD patients receiving anti-TNF therapy.MethodsElectronic databases were searched to identify relevant studies.

pmc-10593766.title: Emerging threats and opportunities to managed bee species in European agricultural systems: a horizon scan
pmc-10593766.creator: Bryony K. Willcox, Simon G. Potts, Mark J. F. Brown, Anne Alix, Yahya Al Naggar, Marie-Pierre Chauzat, Cecilia Costa, Antoine Gekière, Chris Hartfield, Fani Hatjina, Jessica L. Knapp, Vicente Martínez-López, Christian Maus, Teodor Metodiev, Francesco Nazzi, Julia Osterman, Risto Raimets, Verena Stro
pmc-10593766.description: Managed bee species provide essential pollination services that contribute to food security worldwide. However, managed bees face a diverse array of threats and anticipating these, and potential opportunities to reduce risks, is essential for the sustainable management of pollination services.

pmc-10722063.title: Predicting the microvascular invasion and tumor grading of intrahepatic mass-forming cholangiocarcinoma based on magnetic resonance imaging radiomics and morphological features
pmc-10722063.creator: Shuang Chen, Yumeng Zhu, Lijuan Wan, Shuangmei Zou, Hongmei Zhang
pmc-10722063.description: BackgroundPreoperative diagnosis of microvascular invasion (MVI) and tumor grading of intrahepatic mass-forming cholangiocarcinoma (IMCC) using imaging findings can facilitate patient treatment decision-making. This study was conducted to establish and validate nomograms based on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) radiomics and morphological features for predicting the MVI and tumor grading of IMCC before radical hepatectomy.

pmc-11591787.title: AST-120 Protects Cognitive and Emotional Impairment in Chronic Kidney Disease Induced by 5/6 Nephrectomy
pmc-11591787.creator: Yeon Hee Yu, Hyuna Im, Samel Park, Beomjong Song, Dae-Kyoon Park, Duk-Soo Kim, Hyo-Wook Gil
pmc-11591787.description: Background: Uremic toxins resulting from chronic kidney disease (CKD) can cause cognitive and emotional disorders, as well as cardiovascular diseases. Indoxyl sulfate (IS) and p-cresol are notable uremic toxins found in patients with CKD. However, few studies have investigated whether reducing uremic toxins can alleviate cognitive and emotional disorders associated with CKD.

pmc-11654374.title: “Are we genuinely going to have our voices heard?” The experience of co-producing a blended intervention to prevent relapse in obsessive-compulsive disorder: a qualitative study on the perspectives of experts by lived experience
pmc-11654374.creator: Josie FA Millar, Nina Higson-Sweeney, Tom A Jenkins, Erin F Waites, Sophie Minns
pmc-11654374.description: IntroductionCo-production involves researchers, practitioners and people with lived experience working in a collaborative manner, with shared power. The potential benefits of co-production are well documented. However, there is little research describing the experience of having been involved in co-production from the perspective of Experts By Lived Experience (EBLE).

pmc-12378299.title: Enhancing nonformal caregiver capacity in rural areas through community educational interventions
pmc-12378299.creator: Isnaria Rizki Hayati, Rikas Saputra, Yenni Lidyawati
pmc-12378299.description: highlights the urgent need to enhance the capacity of informal caregivers in rural areas through community-based educational interventions and the urgency of ensuring equitable access to palliative care services amid geographical challenges and limited resources. First, we appreciate the quasi-experimental methodology with a pretest–posttest design employed by the authors.

pmc-12775160.title: Circulating exosomal miR-20b-5p and miR-1273g-3p were potential biomarkers for diagnosis and prognosis of acute coronary syndrome
pmc-12775160.creator: Ruiqiang Weng, Xia Li, Junli Zhao, Xiaodong Gu, Sudong Liu
pmc-12775160.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAcute coronary syndrome (ACS) remains one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. This study investigates the diagnostic and prognostic value of circulating exosomal miR-20b-5p and miR-1273g-3p in ACS.MethodsThis retrospective study randomly included 138 patients diagnosed with ACS according to the 2020 European Society of Cardiology (ESC) Guidelines for managing ACSs and 129 controls with normal coronary arteries (NCA) between October 2020 and November 2023 in Meizhou People’s Hospital. Plasma-derived exosomes were isolated from patients with ACS and NCA controls.

pmc-13055272.title: The novel pseudo-compound transposon Tn7086 carries aminoglycoside resistance genes in Enterococcus faecalis
pmc-13055272.creator: Lorenzo Colombini, Mariana Tirziu, Stefano De Giorgi, Anna Maria Cuppone, Giuseppe Sangiorgio, Carmelo Bonomo, Dafne Bongiorno, Stefania Stefani, Susanna Ricci, Gianni Pozzi, Francesco Santoro, Francesco Iannelli
pmc-13055272.description: Enterococcus faecalis is a member of the human gut microbiota and a pathogen responsible for mild and severe infections. Here, genome analysis of E. faecalis strains isolated from different body sites revealed the presence of a novel family of IS1216E-flanked pseudo-compound transposons carrying aminoglycoside resistance genes and other resistance determinants.

pmc-13179848.title: Pediatric Ogilvie Syndrome Following Laparoscopic Appendectomy: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-13179848.creator: Jennyvette Trinidad-Pineiro, Humberto Lugo, Priscilla Dávila, Hiram J Diaz-Cortes, Cristhian G Negron Rodriguez, Sandra Cuevas-Rodriguez
pmc-13179848.description: Acute colonic pseudo-obstruction (ACPO), or Ogilvie syndrome, is a rare cause of massive colonic dilation in children, occurring without mechanical obstruction. Its subtle presentation often mimics ileus or bowel obstruction, which may delay diagnosis and increase the risk of ischemia or perforation.

pmc-13401718.title: Forebrain Lineage Factor DMRTA2 Is Not Required for Maintenance of H3G34‐Mutant Paediatric High‐Grade Gliomas
pmc-13401718.creator: Raul B. Bressan, Oliva Sanchez, Carlos Alberto Oliveira de Biagi‐Junior, Raúl Torres‐Ruiz, Gustavo Alencastro Veiga Cruzeiro, Irene Salgado, Sandra Rodriguez‐Perales, Eduardo Caleiras, Zaira Vega, Gillian Morrison, Steven M. Pollard, Mariella G. Filbin, Manuel Valiente
pmc-13401718.description: Developmental transcriptional programs are increasingly recognized as key drivers of paediatric gliomagenesis. Here, we unexpectedly find that the forebrain‐specific doublesex‐ and mab‐3‐related transcription factor a2 (DMRTA2), despite being highly expressed in H3G34‐mutant diffuse hemispheric glioma (DHG‐H3G34) and implicated in tumour initiation, is not required for the maintenance of established patient‐derived tumour cells.
